description: A Drupal migration process plugin class for handling Drupal 6 file fields, including lookup and transformation logic.

classes.name: FieldFile
classes.description: A migration process plugin for Drupal 6 file fields, deprecated in Drupal 11.3.0 and removed in 12.0.0, used for transforming file data during migration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for the FieldFile plugin, initializes migration and lookup services.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the plugin with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms input data by looking up the migrated file ID and returning the appropriate array or empty array if not found.
